The execution failed due to incorrect financial calculations in the output, specifically regarding program margins and total annual margins.
The test_rows_and_order failed with an AssertionError when comparing program values: close(302.4, 4536.0) returned False. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed because the calculated total_annual_margin_10_day_usd (-61983.9) did not match the expected value (-79751.7). While the program order and keys were correct (3 tests passed), the numerical logic for cost-benefit totals is flawed and requires re-calculation.
